name: Straits Energy Resources Berhad
overview: 2026年，Straits Energy Resources Berhad 完成收购 Straits CommNet Solutions Sdn Bhd 额外18%股权，使其成为持股比例更高的子公司；并寻求股东授权在12个月内通过 NASDAQ 市场出售所持 CBL International Limited 的26.80%股权。此外，公司终止了收购 Sinar Maju Logistik Sdn Bhd 剩余10%股权的选择权，并完成一项私募配售。
overview_en: In 2026, Straits Energy Resources Berhad completed the acquisition of an additional 18% equity interest in Straits CommNet Solutions Sdn Bhd, and proposed to diversify into EPCC services and seek a shareholders' mandate to dispose of its 26.80% stake in CBL International Limited via NASDAQ over 12 months. The company also mutually terminated a call option to acquire the remaining 10% equity interest in Sinar Maju Logistik Sdn Bhd and completed a private placement.

segments.name: 内陆运输与物流服务
segments.note: 公司终止了收购 Sinar Maju Logistik Sdn Bhd 剩余10%股权的选择权。
segments.note_en: The company mutually terminated the call option to acquire the remaining 10% equity interest in Sinar Maju Logistik Sdn Bhd.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 公司与 Tan Sri Mohd Bakri 于2026年9月30日签订相互终止函，终止收购 Sinar Maju Logistik Sdn Bhd 剩余10%股权的选择权。
actions.text_en: The company and Tan Sri Mohd Bakri entered into a letter of mutual termination on 30 September 2026 to terminate the call option to acquire the remaining 10% equity interest in Sinar Maju Logistik Sdn Bhd.

segments.name: 电信与网络服务及船对船作业
segments.name_en: Telecommunication and networking services and ship-to-ship o
segments.note: 公司完成收购 Straits CommNet Solutions Sdn Bhd 额外18%股权，并延长与 Horizon Shipyard Inter Globe (M) Sdn Bhd 的谅解备忘录。
segments.note_en: The company completed the acquisition of an additional 18% equity interest in Straits CommNet Solutions Sdn Bhd and extended its MOU with Horizon Shipyard Inter Globe (M) Sdn Bhd.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Straits CommNet Solutions Sdn Bhd 与 Horizon Shipyard Inter Globe (M) Sdn Bhd 同意将谅解备忘录延长12个月至2027年8月19日。
actions.text_en: Straits CommNet Solutions Sdn Bhd and Horizon Shipyard Inter Globe (M) Sdn Bhd mutually agreed to extend the MOU for a further 12 months to 19 August 2027.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 收购 Straits CommNet Solutions Sdn Bhd 18%股权的先决条件于2026年5月21日达成，收购同日完成。
actions.text_en: The conditions precedent for the acquisition of 18% equity interest in Straits CommNet Solutions Sdn Bhd were fulfilled on 21 May 2026, and the acquisition was completed on the same date.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 064,198 向 ZoomPixel Sdn Bhd 收购 Straits CommNet Solutions Sdn Bhd 的180,000股普通股（占18%股权）。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of 180,000 ordinary shares in Straits CommNet Solutions Sdn Bhd, representing 18% equity interest, from ZoomPixel Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM6,064,198.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 并寻求股东授权出售所持 CBL International Limited 的26.80%股权；同时完成一项私募配售。
segments.note_en: The company proposed to diversify into EPCC services and seek a shareholders' mandate to dispose of its 26.80% stake in CBL International Limited, and completed a private placement.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 在12个月内通过 NASDAQ 市场出售所持 CBL International Limited 的7,369,588股普通股（占26.80%股权）。
actions.text_en: Proposed shareholders' mandate to dispose of 7,369,588 ordinary shares in CBL International Limited, representing 26.80% equity interest, via the NASDAQ open market over 12 months.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 私募配售的99,446,227股配售股份于2026年5月7日在 Bursa Securities ACE Market 上市报价，私募配售完成。
actions.text_en: 99,446,227 placement shares pursuant to the private placement were listed and quoted on the ACE Market of Bursa Securities on 7 May 2026, completing the private placement.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 进入公司此前没有的工程、采购、施工及调试业务。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed diversification into EPCC services, entering engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning business that the company did not previously have.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text_en: Proposed shareholders' mandate to dispose of the 26.80% equity interest in CBL International Limited, potentially exiting this investment.
